title: Google Will Let Mac Users Talk To Gemini Simply By Pressing The 'Fn' Key
excerpt: Users only have to long-press the ‘fn’ key on the bottom left corner of their keyboard to talk to Gemini on Mac.
content_html:
They can make Gemini transcribe spoken words or give it commands related to what’s open on their screen.

Google

Starting today, Gemini users on Mac will be able to talk to the AI chatbot from any window on their computer simply by long-pressing the "fn" button on the bottom left corner of their keyboard. They can use the feature to transcribe spoken words at the cursor, so the chatbot can take notes as they read sources or brainstorm out loud. Google says Gemini will return a polished transcript by automatically removing "ums" and "ahs."

If users opt into the chatbot's screen-aware reasoning capability, Gemini will be able to see and understand what's on the screen and identify open apps to execute complex tasks. Users can, for instance, highlight text in an open PDF document and then press "fn" to tell Gemini to create a summary for it. Or, they can highlight text from their notes and then tell Gemini to draft an email from the information in those notes if they have access to Gemini's Spark agentic AI. Users can also get Gemini to generate images for them, say, by vocally describing what they want to see or getting the chatbot to look at ideas open on their screen.

Google launched its native Gemini app for macOS in April, a day after it released the native Windows app. In June, Google added its Spark agentic AI assistant to the app, giving it the ability to do complex tasks, such as asking it to create new spreadsheets or documents. Now, it's rolling out this feature to all Gemini users on macOS around the world. While it only supports English for now, the company says support for more languages is coming later this year.

content_html_zh:
他们可以让 Gemini 转录口语或向其发出与屏幕上打开的内容相关的命令。

谷歌

从今天开始，Mac 上的 Gemini 用户只需长按键盘左下角的“fn”按钮，就可以从计算机上的任何窗口与 AI 聊天机器人对话。 他们可以使用该功能转录光标处的口语单词，这样聊天机器人就可以在阅读来源或大声集思广益时做笔记。 谷歌表示，Gemini 将通过自动删除“ums”和“ahs”来返回一份经过修饰的文字记录。

如果用户选择聊天机器人的屏幕感知推理功能，Gemini 将能够看到并理解屏幕上的内容，并识别打开的应用程序来执行复杂的任务。 例如，用户可以突出显示打开的 PDF 文档中的文本，然后按“fn”告诉 Gemini 为其创建摘要。 或者，他们可以突出显示笔记中的文本，然后告诉 Gemini 根据这些笔记中的信息起草一封电子邮件（如果他们可以访问 Gemini 的 Spark 代理 AI）。 用户还可以让 Gemini 为他们生成图像，例如，通过口头描述他们想看到的内容或让聊天机器人查看屏幕上打开的想法。

谷歌于 4 月份推出了适用于 macOS 的原生 Gemini 应用程序，就在发布原生 Windows 应用程序的第二天。 6 月，谷歌在该应用程序中添加了 Spark 代理人工智能助手，使其能够执行复杂的任务，例如要求它创建新的电子表格或文档。 现在，它正在向全球 macOS 上的所有 Gemini 用户推出此功能。 虽然目前仅支持英语，但该公司表示，今年晚些时候将支持更多语言。
